messages:
Ava (CEO): quick thread for follow-ups on the security segment — drop short Qs about SOC2/ISO timing, VPC/private deploys, KMS/BYOK, audit logs.
Diego (Support): customer asked whether we provide signed audit bundles for legal eDiscovery. what do we offer?
Samir (Head of Security): we can provide signed, time-stamped audit bundles (NDJSON) for Dedicated/Private. for hosted we offer an export service under enterprise contracts. bundles include checksums and a sig file.
Lena (Compliance): SOC2 update: evidence collection template will be shared next week. ISO kickoff still on track for Q4 but depends on some infra controls.
Diego (Support): for hosted customers worried about data residency, can they pin region for logs and compute?
Samir (Head of Security): yes, region pinning available for Dedicated/Private; hosted has regional coverage but we can offer region commitment as an add-on for enterprise.
infra-bot: Deploy notice: security docs updated -> https://redwood.example.com/security/kms-byok (automated)
Ava (CEO): thanks — we'll collate requests and prioritize hosted-BYOK feasibility for top 3 customers who asked.
Samir (Head of Security): follow-up: any customer needing immediate signed bundles, DM me and we'll queue an export.
Lena (Compliance): adding action: share retention policy matrix with sales by EOD.
Ava (CEO): closing — keep questions here if they pop up. :white_check_mark:
